Apply in this order once reachable: 1) elementor/manage-global-variable for each entry in global_variables, 2) elementor/manage-classes for each entry in global_classes, 3) elementor/build-composition with the composition block below, against the single-location template's content, parent_id: 'document', mode: 'replace_children'. See elementor-templates/README.md for the manual (no-MCP) path.

title.content: Austin businesses get more customers. Not more spend.

paragraph.content: Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO and web builds for the Austin market. No lock-in. No vague promises.
Why Austin businesses work with Apex

title.content: Marketing channels built for the Austin market.

paragraph.content: Paid acquisition and the infrastructure that makes it convert — tuned to how Austin buyers actually search.
Local search and map-pack campaigns built around Austin's highest-value neighborhoods.
Facebook and Instagram campaigns, from new-customer offers to awareness across Central Texas.
Rankings, organic traffic, and a Google Business Profile that looks credible to Austin searchers.
Conversion-focused pages with call tracking, so every Austin lead source is accounted for.

title.content: Also serving the greater Austin area.
Do you work with businesses outside Austin?

paragraph.content: Yes — Apex works with businesses across the US. Austin is one of several markets we actively serve; the process, pricing and guarantee are the same everywhere.

title.content: How fast can an Austin campaign launch?

paragraph.content: Most accounts go live within one to two weeks of the strategy call, once tracking and the landing page are in place. Your free audit gives you a specific timeline before you commit to anything.
No. Every plan is month-to-month. Leave anytime — no notice period, no termination fee, no conversation about it.

title.content: What's included in the free audit?

paragraph.content: We map your current spend, buying cycle and cost of a bad click, and tell you plainly what we'd change — before you pay us anything.

title.content: Do you work with competing businesses in the same city?

paragraph.content: We don't offer blanket exclusivity by default — most clients choose month-to-month specifically because nothing is locked up long-term. If category exclusivity in Austin matters for your business, raise it on the audit call and we'll tell you plainly whether it's workable for your industry and spend level.

“I’ve managed over 1,000 ad accounts, and the story is almost always the same: a recycled playbook, vanity metrics, and a contract you can’t escape. So I made one rule — we report on the only number that matters. Appointments booked. Not impressions. Not clicks.”
Nathan — founder, Apex Marketing. Most clients just call me Nate.
